messages:
maria: quick sketch — trying 'cascade-hyperspec-lite' as a cheap speculative decode variant for the new quant 13B. goal: 2-2.5x token throughput with <1% quality delta on Rouge/Helm. putting plan here.

kevin: short summary of approach?

maria: run a shallow predictor (lightweight head) for first pass; if confident, emit early; else fallthrough to full decode. predictor runs in fp16 cached prefix, costs ~0.02ms/token.

diana: how do you measure 'confident'? thresholding on softmax gap?

maria: yes. use gap + entropy; tuned on small holdout. also add ngram-blocking check to avoid degenerate early stops.

kevin: sounds like classic early-stop + cascade. how to avoid bias from quant noise?

maria: that's the thing — quant jitter may change gap calibration. plan: per-quant-run re-calibration using 5k prompt holdout + isotonic mapping.

diana: eval plan?

maria: cohort sweep: 10k prompts across web/questions/dialogue/longform. metrics: exact-match/ROUGE/BLEU, perplexity shift, and human spot checks (50 per cohort). measure token throughput and p95 latency.

kevin: CI jobs?

ops-bot: ci/cascade-lite-sanity started — job 14232. logs: https://ci/internal/14232

maria: quick config (proto):
```
speculative:
  predictor:
    model: tiny-head-512
    threshold_gap: 0.18
    threshold_entropy: 3.5
  fallback: full-decode-13b-quant
  max_prefix_len: 64
```

diana: run on 8 A100s or single GPU per shard?

maria: bench both. single-GPU microbench for latency; multi-GPU for throughput. expected microbench ~0.9x p95 vs baseline for early hits, 1.2-2.5x token/sec overall.

kevin: what about failure modes?

maria: hallucination spikes on rare long-context Qs; mitigate with trust-decay (require longer prefix + higher gap) and always fallback for "system:" prompts.

diana: calibration schedule?

maria: re-calibrate whenever quant run changes (bits or kernel). automate: after any build whose tag includes 'quant'. small job: 5k holdout -> optimize thresholds -> checkpoint artifact.

kevin: would love a quick ablation: no-ngram vs ngram, gap-only vs gap+entropy.

maria: yes adding to run matrix. also add seed variance check (5 seeds).

diana: can you add a small human label UI for the 50 spot checks? i'll volunteer to label.

maria: thanks! I'll drop links when the job finishes. tagging @kevin for infra help on multi-GPU runs.

kevin: got it, will provision 3x 8-GPU nodes for throughput sweep.

ops-bot: ci/cascade-lite-sanity job 14232 completed — 13 passed, 2 flaky tests. artifacts at https://ci/internal/14232/artifacts

maria: early results (first 2k prompts): avg token/sec +1.9x, p95 latency up for fallbacks only. quality delta ~0.7% on rouge-L. sharing plots in a sec.

diana: nice. post plots here and we'll decide go/no-go for next canary.

maria: uploaded plots -> https://s3/internal/cascade-lite/plots/1812349999.png :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

kevin: next steps: (1) run full 10k cohort, (2) seed & quant variance, (3) human spotcheck. assign owners?

maria: i'll own 1+2, diana owns 3, kevin infra. i'll update ticket INF-423.
